description: Classification taxonomy for the AI-Powered Discovery Engine. Myntra wishlist-to-purchase behavior.

purchase_outcome.question: Foundational — connects every tag to conversion
purchase_outcome.description: Did the user purchase the wishlisted product? Every question in the brief is really asking what leads to purchase vs. not.
purchase_outcome.note: Never skip in theme explosion — conversion mix (purchased_n, not_purchased_n, unclear_n) is required for every other theme.

wishlist_motive.question: 1. Why do users add products to wishlist?
wishlist_motive.description: The reason the user added a product to their wishlist.

purchase_blocker.question: 2. What prevents wishlisted products from being purchased?
purchase_blocker.description: The primary barrier that prevented the user from purchasing a wishlisted product.

post_selection_uncertainty.question: 3. What uncertainties remain after identifying a liked product?
post_selection_uncertainty.description: What the user is still unsure about after shortlisting a product.

purchase_postponement_reason.question: 4. What causes purchase postponement?
purchase_postponement_reason.description: Why the user delayed purchasing a product they intended to buy.

comparison_behavior.question: 5. How do users compare shortlisted products?
comparison_behavior.description: How the user compared multiple shortlisted products before deciding.

external_info_sought.question: 6. What information do users seek outside Myntra?
external_info_sought.description: What external information the user sought before making a purchase decision.

fit_size_signal.question: 7. Role of fit/size
fit_size_signal.description: Whether fit or size was mentioned as a factor in the user's decision.

styling_signal.question: 7. Role of styling
styling_signal.description: Whether styling was mentioned as a factor in the user's decision.

price_signal.question: 7. Role of price
price_signal.description: Whether price was mentioned as a factor in the user's decision.

reviews_signal.question: 7. Role of reviews
reviews_signal.description: Whether reviews were mentioned as a factor in the user's decision.

occasion_signal.question: 7. Role of occasion
occasion_signal.description: Whether a specific occasion was mentioned as a factor in the user's decision.

social_validation_signal.question: 7. Role of social validation
social_validation_signal.description: Whether social validation (friends, influencers, social media) was mentioned as a factor.

wishlist_intent_type.question: 8. Genuine purchase intent vs. bookmarking?
wishlist_intent_type.description: Whether the user's wishlist behavior reflects genuine intent to buy or just bookmarking.

segment_signal.question: 9. How do behaviors differ across segments?
segment_signal.description: User segment signals — tagged ONLY when explicitly evident in the text. Never inferred.

unmet_need.question: 10. What unmet needs recur across conversations?
unmet_need.description: A short phrase describing an unmet need (e.g. 'better size guide', 'video try-on'). Aggregated later to surface recurring phrases.

sentiment.question: Supporting — needed to make counts meaningful
sentiment.description: Overall sentiment of the text. Distinguishes complaints from compliments on the same theme. Feeds severity auto-detection.
sentiment.note: Sentiment is never a ranked theme. It only feeds severity calculation via co-occurrence with purchase_outcome.

notes.immutable_rule: Do not add fields or enum values beyond this set.
notes.segment_rule: segment_signal is evidence-only — tag only when explicitly stated in the text, never infer.
notes.purchase_outcome_rule: purchase_outcome is never skipped in theme explosion — conversion mix is required for every other theme.
notes.sentiment_rule: sentiment is not a ranked theme — it only feeds severity.
